content.thinking: I keep making bracket errors: `cases=[case('a',H)]` — the list needs a closing bracket: `cases=[case('a',H)]`. In line 15 I wrote `cases=[case('a',H)` missing `]`. Let me be careful. Let me define a helper function to build docs to avoid these typos.

arguments.command:
cat >> /workspace/mytests/harness.py <<'PYEOF'

def doc(cases=None, events=None, channels=None, definitions=None, seed="s", timeout_ms=10):
    return {"seed": seed, "definitions": definitions or [], "timeout_ms": timeout_ms,
            "cases": cases or [], "events": events or [], "channels": channels or []}

def ch(name, *parts):
    return {"name": name, "parts": [{"case": c, "data": d} for c, d in parts]}

def chk(label, d, expect_error=True, quiet=False):
    import time
    t = time.time()
    o, rc, err = run(d)
    got = 'error' in o
    ok = (got == expect_error) and rc == 0
    if not quiet or not ok:
        print(('OK  ' if ok else 'BAD '), label, '->', 'error' if got else 'accepted',
              '%.2fs' % (time.time()-t), (err.strip()[-300:] if err.strip() else ''))
    return o
PYEOF
cd /workspace/mytests && timeout 900 python3 - <<'EOF'
from harness import *
H=[{"Type":"headers","End_Stream":True,"data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"]]}]
req = "GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.example\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\n\r\n"
CASES=[case('a',H)]
chk('20000 requests', doc(cases=CASES, channels=[ch('c',('a','{{ %r * 20000 }}' % req))]), expect_error=False)
chk('20001 requests', doc(cases=CASES, channels=[ch('c',('a','{{ %r * 20001 }}' % req))]), expect_error=True)
chunk = "POST / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.example\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n"
one = '{{ %r + b"1\\r\\nz\\r\\n" * %d + b"0\\r\\n\\r\\n" }}'
P=[case('a',H,method='POST')]
chk('40000 chunk lines', doc(cases=P, channels=[ch('c',('a', one % (chunk, 39999)))]), expect_error=False)
chk('40001 chunk lines', doc(cases=P, channels=[ch('c',('a', one % (chunk, 40000)))]), expect_error=True)
EOF
